verdict.rationale: Isaac Sim documents integration into existing testing and validation pipelines, workflow automation, and software-in-the-loop end-to-end evaluation. It also supports Docker for repeatable setups, standalone scripts, and headless operation, which are the ingredients for simulation-based testing in automation. However, nothing documents CI integration specifically, nor a regression-test harness or pass/fail reporting. missing for 10: explicit CI pipeline integration docs (e.g. GitHub Actions/GitLab runners with GPU), a documented simulation regression-test framework with assertions/reporting, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run automated tests of robot software in CI, including simulation-based regression tests

citations.quote: integrate framework capabilities into existing testing and validation pipelines, or automate workflows
evaluate the end-to-end system in Isaac Sim using software-in-the-loop or hardware-in-the-loop testing.
Run Isaac Sim in Docker for repeatable setups
deploy easily with standalone headless operation, from workstation to data center.
